workshoptitle: Product Recall Assistant: Automate Secure Returns Decisions

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: See Kevin’s returns outcome, David’s architecture, and Tim’s eight-lab implementation.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Decide Whether to Open the Case: Shape the Recall Evidence with JSON
tutorials.description: Kevin needs a traceable B-482 decision; David keeps JSON and operational evidence together, and Tim opens the case.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Put Help Where It Is Needed: Map Recall Impact with Oracle Spatial
tutorials.description: Kevin needs a return-response plan; David designs location-aware coverage, and Tim assigns each affected store to a nearby center.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Find the Source and the Reach: Trace Recall Paths with SQL Property Graph
tutorials.description: Kevin needs cause-to-exposure traceability; David models connected paths, and Tim traces lots, suppliers, stores, and customers.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Hear the Signal in the Noise: Prioritize Complaint Evidence with AI Vector Search
tutorials.description: Kevin needs the strongest thermal-risk complaints; David keeps semantic ranking inside the recall boundary, and Tim verifies the evidence.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Answer with Evidence: Build the Recall Assistant
tutorials.description: Kevin needs trusted answers without database access; David defines governed tools, and Tim builds the recall assistant.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Put Trusted Facts in Reach: Publish the Recall API with ORDS
tutorials.description: Kevin needs safe application delivery; David defines a narrow contract, and Tim publishes protected recall JSON and GeoJSON.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Show Each Role Only What It Needs: Make the Recall Agent Role-Aware with Deep Data Security
tutorials.description: Kevin needs each role to see only its scope; David puts authorization in retrieval, and Tim verifies the role-aware results.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Turn Evidence into Coordinated Action: Deploy the Role-Aware React Recall Command Center
tutorials.description: Kevin needs one secure returns command center; David joins the components, and Tim delivers the authorized application experience.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
